literal: noble family - those born - even among - poverty - disgraceful - word - that are born - weakness - will give
translation: Poverty brings a weakness that gives rise to disgraceful words, even among those born in noble families.
modern: நல்ல குடியில் பிறந்தவர்களிடத்திலும், வறுமையானது இழிவான சொற்கள் பிறப்பதற்குக் காரணமான சோர்வினை உண்டாக்கும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how poverty can degrade even the most refined people. The word 'இல்' (il) here specifically means a noble or good family. 'இன்மை' (iṉmai), meaning poverty, is shown as a destructive force that brings 'சோர்வு' (cōrvu), a mental or moral weakness. Because of this weakness, even those raised with high standards may end up speaking 'இளிவந்த சொல்' (iḷivanda col), which are disgraceful or undignified words.
